# ATT&CK catalog

`attack-techniques.json` and `attack-mapping.json` are a subset of traust's pinned tables
(`harnessing/attack-coverage/tables/`, Enterprise ATT&CK v19.1, public MITRE data): the techniques
three category and three capability entries map to, plus a revoked (T1562) and a deprecated
(T1026) technique for the refusal cases.
